"import os

def w(path, text):
    d = os.path.dirname(path)
    if d:
        os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, "w") as f:
        f.write(text)

# Domain: 9 x 1 x 2 m; hot floor 305 K, cold ceiling 290 K
LX, LY, LZ = 9.0, 1.0, 2.0
T_HOT, T_COLD = 305.0, 290.0
DT, END, WRITE = 1.0, 1000.0, 50.0
NX, NY, NZ = 90, 10, 1   # 900 cells total (2D-like, well under 5000 cap)

w("system/controlDict",
    'FoamFile { format ascii; class dictionary; object controlDict;'
    ' location "system/controlDict"; }\n'
    'application     buoyantFoam;\n'
    'startFrom       latestTime;\n'
    'startTime       0;\n'
    'stopAt          endTime;\n'
    f'endTime         {END};\n'
    f'deltaT          {DT};\n'
    'writeControl    runTime;\n'
    f'writeInterval   {WRITE};\n'
    'purgeWrite      0;\n'
    'writeFormat     ascii;\n'
    'writePrecision  6;\n'
    'timeFormat      general;\n'
    'runTimeModifiable true;\n'
)

w("system/fvSchemes",
    'FoamFile { format ascii; class dictionary; object fvSchemes;'
    ' location "system/fvSchemes"; }\n'
    'ddtSchemes { default Euler; }\n'
    'gradSchemes { default Gauss linear; }\n'
    'divSchemes\n{\n'
    '    default none;\n'
    '    div(phi,U)  bounded Gauss limitedLinear 0.2;\n'
    '    div(phi,K)  bounded Gauss limitedLinear 0.2;\n'
    '    div(phi,h)  bounded Gauss limitedLinear 0.2;\n'
    '    div(phi,T)  bounded Gauss limitedLinear 0.2;\n'
    '    div(((rho*nuEff)*dev2(T(grad(U))))) Gauss linear;\n'
    '}\n'
    'laplacianSchemes { default Gauss linear corrected; }\n'
    'interpolationSchemes { default linear; }\n'
    'snGradSchemes { default corrected; }\n'
)

    'solvers\n{\n'
